svg.title: Anshul Mohanty
svg.desc: Anshul Mohanty. Builds retrieval that cites chapter and verse. Ships full-stack TypeScript, from crown to cellar. Second dan black belt. Breaks boards, never builds. Plays for the state. Every smash returned with interest. Watches every genre. Stays for the post-credits scene. An orbit of his builds (Voice RAG, Saakshi, CodeFlow) and his pursuits (badminton, films, karate) around a chip engraved AM.

g.text: Builds retrieval that cites chapter and verse.
Ships full-stack TypeScript, from crown to cellar.
Second dan black belt. Breaks boards, never builds.
Plays for the state. Every smash returned with interest.
Watches every genre. Stays for the post-credits scene.

svg.text: I build software with impeccable manners: it shows its workings,
cites its sources, and never invents a figure.
Voice RAG: a 3.4 ms retrieval core
CodeFlow: maps how code fits together
Karate: 2nd dan, breaks boards not builds
